run_task_invariant: Run.workItemId == Session.workItemId; nullable snapshot; no relink after first run

approval.unchanged_reuse: same revision + original effective approval + reviewed unaffected impact + unchanged scope

authorization: evaluate applicable checks only; read/comment do not require machine authority

delivery.R1: manual identifiers + immutable input + dual human acceptance + durable evidence + second-device access + recovery owner

authorization_decisions_without_run: Allowed for read/comment/publish/review; originRunId optional; grantRefs many-to-many

stop_confirmation_contract.changed_input: paused -> stopping -> confirmed stopped before release/start of linked run
stop_confirmation_contract.confirmation_lost: stopping -> unknown; retain lease; reconcile same run/generation
stop_confirmation_contract.hold_disconnect: hold_requested -> unknown; persist controlHold and requestedControl; never infer pause from request
stop_confirmation_contract.reconcile_hold: proven paused -> paused with hold; proven active -> hold_requested; uncertain -> unknown
